name: MrScraper
description: MrScraper exposes a web-data extraction service that allows agents and users to fetch web pages, extract structured records, search Google, inspect usage, and manage saved scrapers.

evidence.claim: MrScraper MCP exposes the MrScraper web-data service through the Model Context Protocol, allowing agents to fetch pages, extract records, search Google, inspect usage, and rerun scrapers.

notes: An official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exists at mrscraper-com/mrscraper-mcp, which exposes the service capabilities for AI agents.
